---
title: "Exploratory Analysis"
author: "Abid Ali Shaikh"
---

-   The Exploratory analysis involves initial general observation of the data for inferential purposes and any hypothesis after wards using statistical methods; the initial general observation involves summary statistics, mean, mode and medians and sometimes standard deviations. There are various R base functions to do it some of them are list below:

    1.  summary(data_frame)

    2.  describe.
